assumptions.text: JwtAuthenticationFilter authorities support fixed PreAuthorize without a platform guard.
assumptions.evidence: current filter maps AuthService permissions to SimpleGrantedAuthority.
assumptions.falsifier: MockMvc or real JWT requests ignore the expected authorities.

assumptions.text: OrganizationService can be reused without modification.
assumptions.evidence: com.ccb.system.org is public; tree(AuthUser) filters tenant/deleted and returns status and hierarchy.
assumptions.falsifier: team lookup or path cannot be implemented without changing its public behavior.

assumptions.evidence: current sys_user/sys_config fields allow safe id/name/phone/code/label projection.
assumptions.falsifier: implementation requires architecture category or DTO types in platform.

assumptions.text: trace_id nullable extension preserves existing operation log writers.
assumptions.evidence: current INSERT statements omit trace_id and current table has no such NOT NULL dependency.
assumptions.falsifier: migration regression breaks an existing log writer.

assumptions.text: fixed forms can reuse shared UI without modifying it.
assumptions.evidence: delivery showcase contains desktop table, mobile cards and UiFormDrawer patterns.
assumptions.falsifier: approved behavior requires shared component change.

assumptions.text: Flyway discovers the exact beforeMigrate SQL callback from the configured migration location without recording it as a versioned migration.
assumptions.evidence: Spring Boot 3.4.4 manages Flyway and the architecture integration test uses the same filesystem location.
assumptions.falsifier: empty Testcontainers migration still reaches V24 without executing the callback or callback appears in flyway_schema_history.
